hero.title: Got questions?
hero.paragraph: Find the information you need to make the most out of JobDeal.

q1.a: JobDeal is an innovative freelance and gig marketplace designed to eliminate middlemen and directly connect contractors with freelancers. This approach reduces costs and increases efficiency providing a secure and transparent platform for various types of jobs.

q2.q: How does JobDeal ensure security and transparency?
q2.a: JobDeal leverages Blockchain decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) principles and artificial intelligence to ensure top-notch security transparency autonomy and automation.

q3.q: What types of jobs can I find on JobDeal?
q3.a: JobDeal offers a wide range of services for both local and global markets covering labor-intensive jobs to intellectual tasks including technology and IT services creative and intellectual services and remote work opportunities.

q4.q: How does JobDeal support charitable causes?
q4.a: JobDeal donates 1% of its profits to charitable causes allowing users to contribute to these initiatives through their participation on the platform.

q5.q: How do I post a job on JobDeal?
q5.a:
1. Log in to JobDeal.
2. Click "+ Create an Ad."
3. Upload project images.
4. Set a descriptive job name.
5. Write a detailed job description.
6. Set a competitive price.
7. Choose the appropriate category and location.
8. Set an expiry date/time.
9. Select a payment method: Escrow + Fiat Cash or Crypto.
10. Publish the ad.

q6.a: Contractors can choose between escrow fiat cash or crypto payments for job listings.

q7.q: How do I ensure the quality of freelancers?
q7.a: After paying the ad fee contractors can access applicant ratings comments and contacts to help select the best freelancer for the job.

q8.q: What if there's a dispute with a freelancer?
q8.a: JobDeal has a dispute resolution module that helps resolve conflicts to ensure satisfaction for both parties.

q9.q: How do I apply for a job on JobDeal?
q9.a:
1. Log in to JobDeal.
2. Browse job listings.
3. Negotiate price and scope.
4. Decide on escrow usage.
5. Apply for the job.

q10.q: How does the escrow system work?
q10.a: Escrow-protected payments ensure that funds are held securely and released upon mutual agreement between the contractor and the freelancer providing a trustworthy payment process.

q11.q: How do I earn additional income on JobDeal?
q11.a: Freelancers can earn additional income through opportunities such as the Watch2Earn and Learn2Earn programs and by participating in the recruit-to-earn program.

q12.q: What benefits do premium members get?
q12.a: Premium members have access to profit-sharing additional features cheaper ad prices better visibility and advanced AI chat features among other benefits.

q13.q: What are the key features of JobDeal?
q13.a:
- AI-based automation for enhanced efficiency.
- Government-grade encryption and blockchain security.
- Flexible escrow services.
- Dispute resolution module.
- Recruit to earn program.
- AI translation chat for seamless communication.
- Microlearning content to earn JobDealCoin (JDC) and micro-credentials.
- DAO governance for transparent decision-making.
- NFT-based user verification.
- Competitive ad fees and charitable contributions.

q14.q: How does JobDeal use AI and Blockchain?
q14.a: AI enhances communication with direct translation personalized search and ad optimization. Blockchain ensures verifiable identities secure transactions and a transparent rating system.

q15.a: JobDealCoin (JDC) facilitates a decentralized platform enabling passive income from various activities and providing benefits such as lower fees and advanced features for premium users.

q16.q: How does the NFT-based user system work?
q16.a: NFT profiles provide verifiable identities for users ensuring authenticity and security in managing personal data.

q17.a: JobDeal's revenue streams include premium memberships advertisement fees bargaining commissions urgent job fees enhanced ad visibility dispute and escrow system fees commercial spots and user data sales.

q18.q: How much does a premium membership cost?
q18.a: Premium memberships average around 12 Euro per month offering additional AI features and benefits.

q19.q: What are the fees for contractors?
q19.a: Contractors pay a 10% fee based on the job value with additional fees for urgent jobs (20%) and enhanced ad visibility (10%).

q20.q: How do freelancers benefit from premium features?
q20.a: Freelancers gain better visibility negotiation opportunities and access to advanced features helping them secure more jobs and improve their earnings.

q21.q: What are JobDeal's plans for the future?
q21.a: JobDeal plans to expand its services to new markets integrate advanced technologies like machine learning and VR and continuously improve the platform based on user feedback. Specific milestones include launching a mobile application enhancing security and privacy and starting the decentralization of JobDeal.

q22.q: When will new features be released?
q22.a:
Key milestones in the roadmap include:
- Q2 2024: Launch of Web3 version 1.34 Watch2Earn AI Translate Chat and more.
- Q3 2024: ICO launch JobDeal Charity Learn2Earn and other enhancements.
- Q4 2024: Integration of Crypto Wallet JobDeal Support and Tip Freelancer.
- Q1 2025: Skillset Classes (Learn2Earn) USA Version Release Mobile Application Development and more.

q23.q: How does JobDeal engage with its community?
q23.a: JobDeal engages with its community through active social media presence regular updates community forums and user feedback mechanisms to ensure continuous improvement and user satisfaction.

q24.q: What customer support options are available?
q24.a: JobDeal offers a comprehensive customer support system including a help desk live chat and a detailed FAQ section to assist users.

q25.q: How can I provide feedback to JobDeal?
q25.a: Users can provide feedback through the platform's community forums surveys and direct communication with the support team. This feedback is actively used to improve services and features.

q26.q: How does JobDeal protect user data?
q26.a: JobDeal prioritizes user data protection with advanced encryption strict privacy policies user control options and regular security audits to ensure data security and privacy.

q27.q: What privacy policies does JobDeal adhere to?
q27.a: JobDeal complies with global regulations like GDPR and CCPA ensuring that user data is handled with the highest standards of privacy and security.

q28.q: Can users control their data on JobDeal?
q28.a: Yes users have full control over their data including options to view edit and delete their information ensuring transparency and trust.
